title: Decentralized robot collaboration
summary: Groups of robots that talk to each other and work out who does what, with no central controller and no fixed leader. Formations, and asymmetric two-robot manipulation such as one holding a bottle while the other unscrews the cap.
scope: arXiv papers, roughly Nov 2021 to Nov 2026

title: LatentToM learning plan
summary: A deep dive into Latent Theory of Mind: rebuild the paper's decentralized diffusion architecture in a 2D two-pusher simulation. Seven modules from diffusion policy through sheaf theory to a full ablation report, each ending in a gate. An optional eighth module tests whether the arms can reach consensus without the shared third-person camera.
scope: About 90 hours, roughly 11 weeks at 8 hours a week
